units.source_text: 次日傍晚，薰中纳言来到二条院。

en.t: The next evening, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, came to the Nijō residence.

units.source_text: 只因私下恋慕二女公子之情转浓，故今日的打扮煞费苦心。

en.t: Because his secret love for the Second Princess had grown stronger, he took extraordinary care with his appearance that day.

units.source_text: 柔软的衣服上浓重地薰足衣香，竟有香气太烈之嫌。

en.t: His soft robes had been heavily perfumed, almost to the point that the fragrance seemed too strong.

units.source_text: 外加手持一把惯用的丁香汁染的扇子。

en.t: In addition, he carried in his hand his usual fan dyed with clove juice.

units.source_text: 全身香气之馥郁不可言喻。

en.t: The richness of the fragrance surrounding his whole body was beyond words.

units.source_text: 二女公子也常常想起当年宇治山庄中那离奇古怪的一夜的光景，

en.t: The Second Princess, too, often remembered the scene of that strange, uncanny night long ago at the villa in Uji,

units.source_text: 虽然看见薰中纳言性情正直无私、斯文一脉，与常人迥不相同，

en.t: and although she saw that Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was upright, selfless, and refined in a way entirely unlike ordinary people,

units.source_text: 但有时恐怕未免会想起：“索性嫁了此人也好。”

en.t: there were surely times when she could not help thinking, "Perhaps it would be better simply to marry this man."

units.source_text: 她已经不是无知小儿，把那可恨的匂亲王同他一比，显然觉得此人优越得多。

en.t: She was no longer an ignorant child, and when she compared him with the hateful Prince Niou, she clearly felt that Kaoru was far superior.

units.source_text: 因念过去常常和他隔物相会，实在对他不起，又恐被他看作不识情趣的女子。

en.t: Thinking how she had so often met him from behind barriers in the past, she felt she had treated him unfairly, and she also feared he might think her a woman without sensibility.

units.source_text: 因此今天请他进入帘内，自己则在正屋帘前添设一个帷屏，坐在稍深的地方和他会谈。

en.t: Therefore, today she invited him inside the blinds, while she set up an additional screen before the curtain of the main room and sat a little farther within to speak with him.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言开言道：“今日虽非小姐特地号唤，但蒙破例许可会面，不胜欣喜，理应立即前来叩访。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, began, "Although I was not specially summoned by you today, I was overjoyed to be granted this exceptional permission to meet, and I ought to have come at once to pay my respects.

units.source_text: 但闻昨日亲王在府，或恐有所不便，因此延至今日。

en.t: But I heard that the Prince was at the residence yesterday, and fearing it might be inconvenient, I delayed until today.

units.source_text: 承于帘内赐坐，减少隔物，可见小生多年以来的愚诚，今已渐蒙谅解，实甚难得啊！”

en.t: To be given a seat within the blinds and to have the barriers between us reduced makes me feel that my foolish sincerity over these many years is at last beginning to be understood, and I am deeply grateful!"

units.source_text: 二女公子还是非常怕羞，似觉话也说不出来。

en.t: The Second Princess was still terribly shy and seemed unable even to speak.

units.source_text: 好容易答道：“先父三周年忌辰，幸蒙赐祭，不胜感激。

en.t: At last she managed to answer, "For the third anniversary memorial of my late father, I was deeply grateful to receive your offering.

units.source_text: 倘照向例默志于心，则区区谢忱亦不能奉达，实甚遗憾，故而……”

en.t: If I had merely kept my thanks silently in my heart as usual, I would not have been able to convey even my small gratitude, which would have been most regrettable, and so..."

units.source_text: 她说时态度十分恭谨，身体逐渐向内退缩，因此言语断断续续，声音隐隐约约。

en.t: As she spoke, her manner was extremely deferential, and she gradually drew back farther inside, so her words came brokenly and her voice grew faint.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言好不心焦，对她说道：“小姐离我太远了！

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, grew very impatient and said to her, "My lady, you are much too far away from me!

units.source_text: 我正想竭诚奉告，并谨聆请教呢。”

en.t: I wish to speak to you with all sincerity and respectfully hear what you have to say."

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得果然相距太远了，便稍稍膝行而前。

en.t: The Second Princess felt that they were indeed too far apart, so she edged forward a little on her knees.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听得她走近来，胸中一阵乱跳，然而立刻镇静下来，装作若无其事的样子。

en.t: Hearing her come closer, Kaoru's heart suddenly pounded, but he immediately calmed himself and pretended that nothing had happened.

units.source_text: 他想起匂亲王对二女公子感情突然冷淡，便直言指责，又殷勤安慰，轻言细语地就各方面说了许多话。

en.t: Remembering how Prince Niou's feelings toward the Second Princess had suddenly cooled, he criticized him frankly, then comforted her attentively and spoke at length in gentle tones on many matters.

units.source_text: 二女公子对匂亲王的怨恨，不便出之于口，她只向他表示“不怨处世难……”的意思，

en.t: The Second Princess could not openly voice her resentment toward Prince Niou, and only hinted to Kaoru at the thought, "Even without resentment, it is hard to live in this world..."

units.source_text: 用寥寥数语来岔开话头，然后诚恳地请求他带她往宇治一行。

en.t: With just a few words she turned the conversation aside, and then earnestly asked him to take her on a visit to Uji.
